- Primary use case: real-time risk scoring in credit underwriting; current latency constraints preventing model refresh cadence.
- Expected pilot buyers: Aisha Malik (Director of Data) will run the implementation pilot; Evan Brooks (VP Finance) is the economic approver.
- Procurement/security ask: Finlytics needs SOC 2/RoB evidence and a short procurement checklist to hand to legal.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm economic buyer and procurement lead so we can align a short approval timeline (you mentioned Evan but please confirm).
2) We’ll share: pilot scope + pricing sketch (attached: pilot-scope-v1.pdf), and a short security one-pager (attached).
3) Schedule a 30m security/IT sync (Ben to lead) to answer SOC 2/infra questions.
4) Internal enablement: we can build a 1-slide ROI for Aisha and an internal email template to help her rally stakeholders. Tessa will draft the talk tracks.

If you can confirm Evan as the econ buyer and the procurement contact (or forward to procurement), I’ll coordinate timing and deliverables.

Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-security-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

Dana / Rishi — I pulled together the short security artifacts you mentioned. Attaching SOC2-summary.xlsx and the same redwood-security-one-pager.pdf we discussed. Key bullet answers below for legal/IT review: 

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; summary in attached spreadsheet (controls scope, last audit date, auditor).
- Data handling: Ingest occurs over TLS; customer data can be restricted to a dedicated VPC in private deployments. KV cache retention defaults to 0 for sensitive flags; we can configure purging policies per pilot.
- Encryption: At-rest via customer-managed KMS optional; in-transit via TLS.
- Logs/Audit: Per-request tracing available for a 90-day default window; extended retention is an add-on.

If useful, I can book a 30-minute tech/security call (Ben + infra engineer) next week — suggest Wed 10/6 or Thu 10/7.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood-security-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

Let me know what additional fields legal needs and I’ll pull them.

-Ben
